title: Lovable’s valuation doubles to $13.3B as European AI coding boom surges
summary: Stockholm AI web development platform Lovable raised $400M in new capital, doubling its benchmark valuation to $13.3B. The transaction cements the autonomous full-stack development platform as Europe’s fastest startup to achieve decacorn status, driven by exponential enterprise developer adoption across European and North American markets.
keyClaims: Lovable closed $400M financing doubling valuation to $13.3B
Fastest European venture-backed startup to achieve decacorn valuation
Exponential developer growth for autonomous full-stack software generation
corroborationNotes: Tech.eu verified funding report and institutional transaction disclosures.

title: Mistral bags €1.7B funding round as ASML takes significant stake
summary: Paris-based frontier AI champion Mistral AI secured €1.7B in fresh capital, with Dutch semiconductor manufacturing giant ASML taking a major strategic stake. The partnership focuses on integrating Mistral’s sovereign reasoning models across European high-tech industrial manufacturing, reducing reliance on American cloud infrastructure while enforcing strict European data residency standards.
keyClaims: Mistral AI secured €1.7B funding round
Semiconductor leader ASML took a significant equity and technology stake
Anchors sovereign AI capabilities in European industrial manufacturing
corroborationNotes: Tech.eu coverage corroborated by ASML corporate investor communications.

title: Polish auto aftermarket platform Autofixer secures €3M from Orbit Capital
summary: Warsaw automotive logistics startup Autofixer closed a €3M venture debt facility from Prague-based Orbit Capital. The platform connects independent repair workshops with automated parts replenishment across Poland and Romania. The non-dilutive capital will finance regional warehouse automation and accelerate software rollout across Central and Eastern Europe without diluting founders.
keyClaims: Autofixer secured €3M in venture debt from Orbit Capital
Funding finances logistics automation and regional CEE expansion
Connects independent auto garages to digital parts inventory
corroborationNotes: Orbit Capital portfolio announcement and Polish commercial registry.

title: Top 10 Most-Funded European Fintechs of H1 2026 Highlighted
summary: European fintech financing in H1 2026 was led by several large transactions across banking, payments, insurtech, wealth management, and financial infrastructure. The Tech.eu analysis highlights the ten most heavily funded startups in the sector, signaling resilient institutional capital deployment into core European financial technology segments despite macroeconomic recalibration.
keyClaims: European fintech funding in H1 2026 concentrated on market champions
Major rounds spanned banking, payments, and wealth infrastructure
Top 10 companies secured over 45% of continental fintech funding

title: Monzo reports revenue and profits leap as it prepares European launch
summary: London fintech unicorn Monzo reported a dramatic leap in revenue and net profitability as it accelerates its European expansion starting with Spain. The digital challenger plans to roll out euro-denominated accounts and retail services, building on its 11 million customers and turning into Europe’s most profitable retail neobank turnaround.
keyClaims: Monzo announced leaping revenue and profitability
Confirmed European rollout starting in Spanish retail banking
Active user base reached 11 million customer accounts
corroborationNotes: Audited annual statements and Tech.eu retail banking coverage.

title: Northvolt files for bankruptcy, ending Europe’s bid for battery independence
summary: Swedish gigafactory pioneer Northvolt filed for bankruptcy in Stockholm after failing to secure a rescue financing package. The collapse marks a profound blow to Europe’s industrial strategy to build an independent electric vehicle supply chain free from Chinese battery dominance, leaving major European automakers to navigate severe supply vulnerabilities.
keyClaims: Northvolt filed for formal bankruptcy in Sweden
Rescue talks failed to raise necessary long-term capital
Pivotal blow to European homegrown EV battery supply chain autonomy
corroborationNotes: Direct Stockholm District Court filings and verified Tech.eu report.

title: NOVUS secures eight-figure funding to take electric Lightbike from Germany to California
summary: German electric mobility company NOVUS secured an eight-figure funding round led by 468 Capital to expand production of its lightweight carbon-fiber electric Lightbike. The capital will accelerate commercial rollout across Europe and support market entry into the United States, expanding high-performance European micro-mobility engineering globally.
keyClaims: NOVUS closed eight-figure financing round led by 468 Capital
Produces handcrafted ultralight monocoque carbon-fiber Lightbike
Expanding manufacturing capacity across Germany and California
corroborationNotes: Tech.eu verified investment report and 468 Capital bulletin.

title: SAP buys TechWolf in record Belgian VC-backed software acquisition
summary: German enterprise software giant SAP finalized a definitive agreement to acquire Ghent-based AI startup TechWolf in the largest venture-backed buyout in Belgian history. TechWolf's AI-driven skills context graph will be embedded inside SAP SuccessFactors and its Joule AI assistant, providing European enterprises with automated workforce intelligence.
keyClaims: SAP acquired Belgian AI skills platform TechWolf
Largest venture-backed software exit in Belgian startup history
Deeply integrated into SAP SuccessFactors and Joule enterprise AI
corroborationNotes: SAP SE corporate release and Tech.eu enterprise M&A review.

title: Einride breaks barriers with world’s first cabless autonomous border crossing
summary: Swedish autonomous freight innovator Einride executed the world's first cabless electric truck border crossing between Sweden and Norway. Operating without a human driver or in-cab safety personnel, the Level-4 commercial vehicle completed digital customs clearance autonomously, demonstrating scalable driverless logistics across European international freight corridors.
keyClaims: Einride completed world-first cabless heavy-truck border crossing
Operated between Swedish and Norwegian freight customs checkpoints
Validated automated cross-border customs data interchange
corroborationNotes: Norwegian Customs and Swedish Transport Agency verification.

title: Nebius constructing one of Europe’s largest AI data centers in Finland
summary: Amsterdam-headquartered AI infrastructure provider Nebius initiated construction on a 310-megawatt high-performance computing center in Lappeenranta, Finland. The facility will house hundreds of thousands of GPUs powered by Finnish renewable grid power, providing European AI researchers and enterprises with dedicated sovereign compute capacity.
keyClaims: Nebius broke ground on 310MW high-density GPU data facility in Finland
Powered 100% by Nordic zero-carbon renewable energy
Significantly scales European sovereign AI computational power
corroborationNotes: City of Lappeenranta utility permits and Tech.eu compute report.

title: Nvidia confirms $12.93B purchase of open-source AI platform Hugging Face
summary: Nvidia reached an agreement to acquire Franco-American open-source AI community platform Hugging Face for $12.93B. Founded in Paris, Hugging Face hosts Europe’s largest repository of open-source weights, datasets, and models. The transaction preserves open European AI research access while integrating optimized acceleration across global AI development pipelines.
keyClaims: Nvidia reached definitive agreement to buy Hugging Face for $12.93B
Preserves Paris and global open-source model community operations
Deeply optimizes open-source pipelines on accelerated computing
corroborationNotes: Tech.eu acquisition confirmation and regulatory disclosures.

title: Salesforce acquires UK AI agent startup Convergence one year after launch
summary: London-based autonomous agent startup Convergence was acquired by Salesforce just twelve months after launch. Convergence created Proxy, an autonomous enterprise agent capable of navigating web applications and executing multi-step business workflows. The acquisition anchors Salesforce's European AI agent development hub in London, accelerating generative workflow automation.
keyClaims: Salesforce acquired UK enterprise agent startup Convergence
Exit completed 12 months following initial startup launch
Expands Agentforce capabilities across complex browser workflows
corroborationNotes: Salesforce corporate announcement and Tech.eu software report.

title: UK AI firm Faculty to be acquired by consulting giant Accenture
summary: London-based AI safety and applied intelligence specialist Faculty agreed to be acquired by Accenture. Faculty developed algorithmic auditing systems and deployed critical predictive intelligence for European healthcare and defense institutions. The deal strengthens Accenture’s sovereign European AI governance and compliance advisory services under the EU AI Act.
keyClaims: Accenture entered definitive agreement to acquire Faculty
Specializes in AI safety auditing and operational intelligence
Provides European enterprises end-to-end EU AI Act governance
corroborationNotes: London corporate filing and Tech.eu advisory sector coverage.
